room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU expenses capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on all admissible claims; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹40,000/eye; Modern Tx 50% SI; AYUSH 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract sub-limit ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; AYUSH capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, hysterectomy, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus defined in policy but no specific rate or cap mentioned in wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: Indicative list of 537 day-care procedures provided in Annexure 2

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under Section 4.2.11

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded (Section 4.2.2)

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Non-payable consumables listed in Annexure 1 List 1; gloves, masks, etc. excluded

global_cover.note: Territorial limit restricted to India; overseas treatment explicitly excluded (Section 4.2.1)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal; no coverage during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions: Overseas treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, ART/HIV treatment costs, STDs, stem cell storage, alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.), maternity
optional_riders: Co-payment waiver (optional add-on to remove 20% co-pay)
